iterations.finding: Independent advisory review of the prior head identified two material UI regressions: the legacy close/export overlays could cover draw.io and the only host status live region was hidden for the entire workspace.
iterations.resolution: Reproduced both from the source contract and corrected them rather than treating the review transport's invalid JSON wrapper as a reason to ignore the findings.

iterations.finding: Simply restoring the old right-side legacy clearance would still leave the new multi-control host dock over the embedded draw.io canvas.
iterations.resolution: Reduced legacy host chrome to Project/PNG/SVG and reserved both a 56px right clearance and 64px bottom clearance. Exact Chromium geometry proves frame right 1310 < close left 1318 and frame bottom 960 < dock top 962.

iterations.finding: Keeping the top header hidden also hides role=status feedback, so export/local-save failures can become silent even if the canvas itself is correct.
iterations.resolution: Converted the existing header into a pointer-free status overlay in workspace mode, hiding only brand/badge. Exact legacy and native readbacks both show the status region visible while retaining full native frame height.

iterations.finding: Changing the four accepted source revisions invalidated the prior single-workspace source bindings and initially caused exactly one full-suite publication binding failure.
iterations.resolution: Added a new immutable successor receipt and publication binding, then reran the full exact-head validation successfully: Ruff, compile, registry and 1654 tests all pass.
